# Licences in TYPO3 4.5.40

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/licence_inventory.py from vendor-src/typo3-4.5.40/typo3_src-4.5.40.tar.gz.

TYPO3 4.5.40 is GPL-2.0-or-later. The release also bundles third-party
code, each part under its own licence. This is every separate licence file in
the release archive, found by its name. The `typo3:4.5.40` image ships the
tree unmodified, so each file is in the image below `/var/www/html`,
and this list is at `/usr/share/doc/typo3-4.5.40/LICENCES.md`.

A licence stated only in a source file's own header is not listed. That code ships
as source, so the header ships with it. The last column says what a file's text
looks like, not which licence applies: read the file for that.

Archive: `vendor-src/typo3-4.5.40/typo3_src-4.5.40.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `d2f4f89ddbf095bd9096db93601f9a3c1736801f393a057a4fbfe152075baee1`.
